title: Keto Jamaican Pork Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy stew made with tender pork and a variety of spices, perfect for a keto diet. Serve hot over cauliflower rice or with a side of vegetables.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the pork and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion and bell pepper to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, Jamaican seasoning, and salt and pepper to taste.
Return the pork to the pot and bring the stew to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the pork is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Serve the stew hot over cauliflower rice or with a side of vegetables.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
